# Aveliq

> What small-team software really costs.

Aveliq publishes software comparisons for freelancers and small teams: invoicing, email, scheduling, sales and AI tools. Prices come from vendor pricing pages, are dated, and are worked out for real team sizes.

## Categories
- [Payments & Invoicing](https://aveliq.net/category/payments): Payment processors, invoicing and client billing tools.
- [Email & Marketing](https://aveliq.net/category/email-marketing): Email, newsletter and marketing tools.
- [Scheduling & Forms](https://aveliq.net/category/scheduling-forms): Booking, scheduling and form builders.
- [Sales & Projects](https://aveliq.net/category/sales): CRMs, outreach and project management.
- [AI Tools for Work](https://aveliq.net/category/ai): AI writing, meeting, voice, video and presentation tools.

## About
- [About Aveliq](https://aveliq.net/about): Editorial approach and transparency.
- [Newsletter](https://aveliq.net/newsletter): Software comparisons for freelancers and small teams.
